system.effect: Wearable protective ward against magic and possession (Class 2–4).
system.description: A small bag of warded materials and a circuit worn on the person — essential field kit. Class 2 issued to all staff; Class 3 to field operatives on request; Class 4 for high-risk missions only. Requisition DN 3:2 (Class 1–2), 4:2 (Class 3), 5:2 (Class 4).
